# Domain Rules

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS - Current state

### Overview

- Users have a type and optional role; roles aggregate named permissions (`app/Models/User.php`, `app/Models/Role.php`).
- Support operations persist command history and deduplicated system-error alerts (`app/Models/CommandExecution.php`, `app/Models/SystemErrorAlert.php`).
- Regions, states, cities, and addresses form a normalized Brazilian geography hierarchy (`app/Models/Region.php`, `app/Models/Address.php`).

### Admin-area access

`TypeUsers::canAccessAdminArea()` allows `Admin`, `User`, and `SupportRemSoft`; `Customer` is redirected to the regular dashboard. Admin routes additionally require authentication, `EnsureUserCanAccessAdminArea`, and route policy checks (`app/Enums/TypeUsers.php`, `routes/admin.php`, `bootstrap/app.php`).

| User type | Admin area |
|---|---|
| Admin | Allowed |
| User | Allowed |
| Customer | Denied |
| SupportRemSoft | Allowed |

New types must define their access outcome in `TypeUsers::canAccessAdminArea()`.

### User and role creation

`CreateUserAction` requires a unique valid email, a 3-191 character name, an 8-191 character password, a valid user-type enum, and an optional existing role. `CreateRoleAction` requires a 3-191 character name and synchronizes only permission names that exist (`app/Brain/Users/Actions/CreateUserAction.php`, `app/Brain/Roles/Actions/CreateRoleAction.php`).

### Error deduplication and notification

`UpsertSystemErrorAlert` groups occurrences by `fingerprint` plus `environment`, increments occurrences, and preserves the current status on repeats. `DiscordAlert` ignores configured exception classes and HTTP failures below 500, classifies HTTP 503+ as emergency, sanitizes sensitive request keys, and throttles notifications by fingerprint (`app/Actions/SystemErrorAlert/UpsertSystemErrorAlert.php`, `app/Support/Alerts/DiscordAlert.php`).

### Controlled Artisan execution

`ExecuteArtisanCommandAction` accepts only commands registered by Artisan, rejects configured blocked commands, applies allowlist/prefix rules when configured, runs once on `long_timeout`, and records output, exit code, duration, and terminal status (`app/Brain/Support/Actions/ExecuteArtisanCommandAction.php`).

| Process outcome | Stored status |
|---|---|
| Queued for worker | Queued |
| Worker begins | InProgress |
| Exit code indicates success | Success |
| Non-zero result or exception | Error |

New execution outcomes must map to `CommandExecutionStatuses` and remain persisted in `command_executions`.

### Media access

Media belongs polymorphically to an entity, stores its disk and collection, and exposes a temporary URL valid for 10 minutes. Known extensions map to PDF/JPEG/PNG/GIF MIME types; other extensions use `application/octet-stream` (`app/Models/Media.php`).
